items.question: How much is the monthly student allowance, in AED, under the UAE Ministry of Health and Prevention Nursing programme scholarship?
items.fact: Nursing programme scholarship monthly student allowance is AED 4,500

items.question: What is the minimum monthly salary, in AED, for graduates of the UAE Ministry of Health and Prevention Nursing programme who are appointed at one of the ministry's medical facilities?
items.fact: Nursing programme graduates minimum salary is AED 20,000 monthly
